{
  "dataset_name": "spambase",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "word_freq_l2_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "L2 norm of all 48 word frequency features, capturing overall word frequency magnitude for scale-normalized distance computation",
      "value_range": [0.0, 35.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes the word frequency space so KNN distances reflect relative patterns rather than absolute magnitudes",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(word_freq_0**2 + word_freq_1**2 + word_freq_2**2 + word_freq_3**2 + word_freq_4**2 + word_freq_5**2 + word_freq_6**2 + word_freq_7**2 + word_freq_8**2 + word_freq_9**2 + word_freq_10**2 + word_freq_11**2 + word_freq_12**2 + word_freq_13**2 + word_freq_14**2 + word_freq_15**2 + word_freq_16**2 + word_freq_17**2 + word_freq_18**2 + word_freq_19**2 + word_freq_20**2 + word_freq_21**2 + word_freq_22**2 + word_freq_23**2 + word_freq_24**2 + word_freq_25**2 + word_freq_26**2 + word_freq_27**2 + word_freq_28**2 + word_freq_29**2 + word_freq_30**2 + word_freq_31**2 + word_freq_32**2 + word_freq_33**2 + word_freq_34**2 + word_freq_35**2 + word_freq_36**2 + word_freq_37**2 + word_freq_38**2 + word_freq_39**2 + word_freq_40**2 + word_freq_41**2 + word_freq_42**2 + word_freq_43**2 + word_freq_44**2 + word_freq_45**2 + word_freq_46**2 + word_freq_47**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "char_freq_l2_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "L2 norm of all 6 character frequency features, capturing punctuation and special character usage intensity",
      "value_range": [0.0, 35.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a compact distance-relevant summary of character-level features for KNN neighborhood geometry",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(char_freq_0**2 + char_freq_1**2 + char_freq_2**2 + char_freq_3**2 + char_freq_4**2 + char_freq_5**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_log_average",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed average capital run length to compress the heavy-tailed distribution for better KNN distance behavior",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces the influence of extreme outliers in capital run length on KNN distance calculations",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_average)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_log_longest",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed longest capital run length to normalize the extreme range of this feature",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses the 1-9989 range into a manageable scale for KNN distance metrics",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_longest)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_log_total",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed total capital run length to normalize the heavy-tailed distribution",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes total capital usage for more balanced KNN distance contributions",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_total)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_length_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of longest to average capital run length, indicating burstiness of capitalization patterns",
      "value_range": [0.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the shape of capital run distribution independent of scale, improving neighborhood similarity",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(capital_run_length_longest / (capital_run_length_average + 1e-6), 0.0, 50.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "word_freq_nonzero_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of word frequency features with non-zero values, measuring vocabulary diversity of the email",
      "value_range": [0.0, 48.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a discrete cluster indicator separating sparse emails from vocabulary-rich ones for KNN grouping",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(word_freq_0 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_1 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_2 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_3 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_4 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_5 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_6 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_7 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_8 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_9 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_10 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_11 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_12 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_13 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_14 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_15 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_16 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_17 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_18 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_19 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_20 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_21 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_22 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_23 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_24 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_25 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_26 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_27 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_28 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_29 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_30 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_31 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_32 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_33 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_34 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_35 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_36 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_37 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_38 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_39 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_40 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_41 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_42 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_43 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_44 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_45 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_46 > 0).astype(float) + (word_freq_47 > 0).astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "char_freq_exclamation_dollar_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of exclamation-related char frequency (char_freq_4) to dollar-sign-related char frequency (char_freq_3), capturing punctuation style balance",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the relative balance of two high-discriminating character types for improved KNN similarity",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(char_freq_4 / (char_freq_3 + 1e-6), 0.0, 20.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_freq_word_concentration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of top high-variance word frequencies (word_freq_18, word_freq_20, word_freq_26) that have the largest standard deviations, indicating concentration in a few dominant words",
      "value_range": [0.0, 52.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Focuses KNN distance on the most variable and discriminating word frequency dimensions",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "word_freq_18 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_26"
    },
    {
      "name": "total_word_freq_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of all word frequency features, representing overall word frequency density of the email",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a single-dimensional summary of total word frequency activity for KNN distance normalization",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(word_freq_0 + word_freq_1 + word_freq_2 + word_freq_3 + word_freq_4 + word_freq_5 + word_freq_6 + word_freq_7 + word_freq_8 + word_freq_9 + word_freq_10 + word_freq_11 + word_freq_12 + word_freq_13 + word_freq_14 + word_freq_15 + word_freq_16 + word_freq_17 + word_freq_18 + word_freq_19 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_21 + word_freq_22 + word_freq_23 + word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + word_freq_27 + word_freq_28 + word_freq_29 + word_freq_30 + word_freq_31 + word_freq_32 + word_freq_33 + word_freq_34 + word_freq_35 + word_freq_36 + word_freq_37 + word_freq_38 + word_freq_39 + word_freq_40 + word_freq_41 + word_freq_42 + word_freq_43 + word_freq_44 + word_freq_45 + word_freq_46 + word_freq_47, 0.0, 100.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_intensity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combined capital run intensity score combining log-normalized average, longest, and total runs into a single composite distance feature",
      "value_range": [0.0, 30.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a compact representation of capitalization behavior that improves KNN neighborhood coherence",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(capital_run_length_average) + np.log1p(capital_run_length_longest) + np.log1p(capital_run_length_total), 0.0, 30.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "email_content_richness",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall email content richness based on the combination of word diversity, character frequency patterns, and capital run behavior. Higher scores indicate emails with richer, more varied content patterns that tend to cluster distinctly in feature space.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic cluster indicator that helps KNN identify emails with similar overall content profiles, improving neighborhood purity",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
